title: triumfetta rhomboidea var. glandulosa
intro: Triumfetta rhomboidea var. glandulosa, commonly known as Glandular Spurflower, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Triumfetta rhomboidea var. glandulosa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in alleviating symptoms of colds, flu, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential use in traditional medicine.
